person: Dario Mendes owns three trucks outside Joliet and drives one himself. On the side he imports trailer parts and truck-cab goods from Asia, a few containers a month, and files his own Importer Security Filings because the bond is in his name. He reads English slowly and uses a phone translator. He is afraid of the $5,000 penalty and of a wrong filing, because his wife keeps the books and will ask. He wants each filing named by order number, supplier and money, in simple words.
stated_up_front: Please, I have containers loading this week and I must file the ISF for each one before the 24 hours. Look at my orders and tell me simple which ones I must file, which ones I must only update, and which ones I do nothing.

facts.about: The company name on the bond and the ISF
facts.truth: Mendes Fleet Supply LLC, Joliet, Illinois
Order MFS-2291, 4,000 LED trailer light sets; sold by a Hong Kong trading company, Harbor Bright Trading; made at a factory in Dongguan, China; loads at Yantian

facts.about: Second ISF due today, sailing moved earlier
facts.truth: Order MFS-2297, truck seat cushions; the carrier moved the sailing five days earlier; the factory is in Guangzhou, China, but the cargo loads at Haiphong, Vietnam, so the country of origin is China, not Vietnam
Order MFS-2304, rubber mud flaps, 1 x 40-foot container, made in a plant in Ningbo, China

facts.about: Filing that needs an update with the factory and stuffing location
facts.truth: Order MFS-2283 was filed with the Hong Kong seller as the maker; on 8 October the supplier named the real factory in Foshan, China, which stuffed the container in Foshan

facts.about: Filing that needs an update with the new warehouse
facts.truth: The ship-to changed from his Joliet yard to a rented warehouse in Memphis, Tennessee, before the container arrives

facts.about: Cargo to leave alone, by air
facts.truth: Sample LED bars, 12 kilograms, came by air express, so no ISF
Loose decorative gravel for his yard, loaded loose in the holds of a bulk carrier, so no ISF

facts.about: Cargo to leave alone, Canadian container
facts.truth: A friend's company in Windsor, Ontario has a container that stays on board at Seattle; the carrier files it, so he does nothing
Order MFS-2288 rolled to a later vessel with the same bill and nothing changed, and the filing for MFS-2279 is complete, so nothing to do on either

unknowns: What a flexible manufacturer means and why it can be updated later
What the tariff number (HTS) on the invoice means and whether his are right
Exactly how many hours before loading the ISF is due and how the time zones count
Whether the carrier or he must file for cargo that stays on board
